record.question: Drugs used for delaying CKD progression includes all except:
record.explanation: Answer D: Sevelamer. Dapagliflozin and empagliflozin have CKD-progression indications in appropriate populations; sevelamer is a phosphate binder, not a general CKD-progression drug. Reference: https://kdigo.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/KDIGO-2024-CKD-Guideline-Executive-Summary.pdf; https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/kidney-disease/chronic-kidney-disease-ckd/healthy-eating-adults-chronic-kidney-disease. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
